subject: Life Skills
title: Emergency Numbers Worldwide
description: A fast breakdown of Emergency Numbers Worldwide for builders.

hook.text: A tourist in London dialed 911. Nothing happened. The UK uses 999. Those seconds of confusion matter in a crisis.

buildup.text: 112 works across all EU countries and many others. The US uses 911. Japan uses 110 for police and 119 for fire.

discovery.text: Most smartphones now let you dial 112 or 911 even on a locked screen or without a SIM card in many regions.

twist.text: Knowing the number is not enough. You also need to describe your location clearly, especially in rural or foreign areas.

climax.text: Before traveling, save the local emergency number in your phone. A ten-second search now could save minutes later.

punchline.text: Wrong number, wrong country, wrong help. Know before you go.

quiz.question: Which emergency number works across all EU countries?
